title: The Crowbar Pawn
setup: Kings on opposite wings. Your queen and rook share the h-file, Black's queen on a5 eyes a2, and only the knight on f6 helps the king guard h7.
hint: Take the knight on f6 away from h7 with the cheapest piece you own, and make it cost Black whatever the reply.
explanation:
## The Idea

Opposite kings make it a race, and Black's queen is already aimed at your king. You strike first, with a pawn. {{e5}} hits the knight on f6, the one piece besides the king that guards h7.

Black's best is to grab a knight back with {{Bxd5}}. It changes nothing: {{exf6}} removes the guard anyway. Once Black recaptures, the queen and rook on the h-file come through h7, and {{Qxh7+}} and {{Qh8+}} drive the king into the middle, where it loses far more than a piece.
